purpose: Close the unfinished 20-node homogeneous steady-load main comparison before any later experiment chapter by testing one label-free causal NSESche policy that preserves the strongest native service processes for each observed arrival regime and admits only same-window service-and-welfare-certified replacements.

paper_sequence_gate.existing_later_chapter_artifacts: Retain unchanged for audit; do not use them to design, select, or claim V149 and do not trigger a downstream chapter from this training plan.
paper_sequence_gate.closure_definition: NSESche must be strictly first on fixed-window throughput, finite-only QPR, and zero-completed-as-zero QPR at low, middle, and high load under the frozen gates below.

frozen_source_evidence.block_design: 10 methods x 3 loads x E01-E20 on exactly paired tapes and environments

adaptive_training_disclosure.opened_training_cohort: all homogeneous E01-E20 baseline outcomes and their paired workload tapes
consulted_results: per-load means and ranks for fixed-window throughput
per-load finite-only QPR means and zero-completed-as-zero QPR means
identity of the strongest frozen baseline for each load and metric
causal cumulative first-seen arrival counts from the paired E01-E20 tapes
fitted_elements: the frame-20 high-load threshold of 70 cumulative first-seen arrivals
the frame-100 low-versus-middle threshold of 213 cumulative first-seen arrivals
OCS as the low-load native cohort, FaaSRank as the middle-load native cohort, and Jiagu as the high-load native cohort
the low-load OCS-cohort Orion projection certificate
adaptive_training_disclosure.reserved_confirmation_seed_ids: E1530-E1549; inputs must not be generated or inspected unless every training gate passes and a separate confirmation plan is committed first

units.qpr: fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost per completed request

causal_load_classifier.runtime_input: cumulative count of first-seen request IDs through the current scheduling frame only
causal_load_classifier.frame_semantics: After observing frames 0-19 inclusive, evaluate the high gate exactly once. If it is false, after observing frames 0-99 inclusive evaluate the low-versus-middle gate exactly once.

route.after_frame_19_if_cumulative_arrivals_at: freeze high and route Jiagu for all later windows
route.after_frame_99_if_cumulative_arrivals_at: freeze middle and route FaaSRank for all later windows

causal_load_classifier.no_runtime_label: The selector must not read request_freq, load name, scenario, topology label, seed, tape path/hash, future arrival, completion, throughput, latency, cost, or QPR.
causal_load_classifier.fail_closed: A frame reset reinitializes before any dispatch; a duplicate, skipped frame, incomplete required history, arithmetic overflow, or inconsistent one-time freeze is sticky-invalid and routes OCS without later reclassification.

native_expert_and_nash_contract.lifecycle: Advance all four unchanged native shadows exactly once in every scheduling window, independent of route selection, on each shadow's own native frontier.

low_load_initializer.cohort: the exact duplicate-free common-HPA placement-feasible OCS native command cohort and OCS command order
low_load_initializer.Orion_projection: For the same OCS players only, project the exact nodes emitted by the persistent Orion All-frontier capture; do not add players, fill a tail, or reorder the OCS cohort.
low_load_initializer.Orion_acceptance: accept only if the projection is complete and feasible, readiness-service maximum is nonworse, readiness-service sum is strictly lower, and immutable-baseline paper welfare is nonworse than exact OCS; otherwise retain exact OCS

native_expert_and_nash_contract.middle_load_initializer: exact complete FaaSRank native assignment on its PreAllDone frontier; no tail fill
native_expert_and_nash_contract.high_load_initializer: exact complete Jiagu native assignment on its All frontier
native_expert_and_nash_contract.nash_candidate: Starting from the selected initializer and on exactly that selected player cohort and order, run the unchanged NSESche solver/reference path.
native_expert_and_nash_contract.nash_acceptance: The proposal must be complete and feasible on the identical cohort, readiness-service maximum nonworse, readiness-service sum strictly lower, and immutable-baseline paper welfare nonworse than the already selected native initializer.
native_expert_and_nash_contract.dispatch: Dispatch exactly the selected native initializer when no replacement passes; otherwise dispatch exactly the certified Orion projection or certified Nash proposal.

hypotheses.primary: The causal route retains the best observed completion-oriented native process for each steady arrival regime, while the low OCS-cohort Orion proposal and same-cohort Nash proposal admit only strict current-service improvements, allowing NSESche to exceed every frozen baseline mean on throughput and both QPR conventions in all three loads.
hypotheses.falsification: V149 is falsified if any causal, native-lifecycle, cohort, projection, dispatch, reference, QC, provenance, or blind-audit invariant fails, or if any one of the nine load-by-metric training gates fails.
hypotheses.no_guaranteed_outcome: The design makes no promise that proxy-safe replacements improve realized end-to-end metrics; failure retires V149 without editing thresholds, experts, seeds, or gates after reveal.

training_design.candidate_order_rule: Commit one seeded permutation of the exact 60 cells before reference construction; attempt every cell once in that order and never reorder after a result or failure.

selection_rule.mean_gate: For each load and metric, the candidate mean must be strictly greater than the maximum mean among all nine frozen non-NSESche baselines.
selection_rule.paired_gate: For each load and metric, candidate minus the preregistered metric-specific ceiling baseline must be strictly positive on at least 12 of 20 paired seeds. Finite-only QPR uses only pairs where both values are finite and additionally requires candidate finite QPR on all 20 seeds; zero-completed-as-zero retains all 20.
selection_rule.candidate_pass: all nine load-by-metric mean gates and all nine paired gates pass
selection_rule.zero_completion: retain the run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero QPR is zero; never impute or replace a seed
selection_rule.failure: retire V149 unchanged and do not generate confirmation inputs

confirmation_boundary.interpretation: This efficient confirmation can establish superiority to the baselines that were strongest in the frozen full matrix. A simultaneous fresh ten-method rank claim would require a separately authorized full fresh comparator matrix; it must not be implied by the 140-run design.

before_reveal: exact 60-cell product in the committed seeded order
attempt-1 QC pass or only preregistered same-cell technical retries with every failed attempt retained
zero unexplained quarantine, valid ledgers, runtime consensus, exact frozen tapes/environments/common HPA/model/SLA bindings
60 new policy-independent references and exact build/replay pairing
first-seen arrival arithmetic, frame continuity, one-time high and low-middle decisions, and sticky route identity
all four persistent native shadows invoked exactly once per window on their own frontiers
exact OCS cohort and ordering for the low branch, complete Orion projection or documented rejection, exact FaaSRank/Jiagu native assignments for middle/high
same-cohort service/welfare certificates and exact dispatched assignment hashes
zero candidate throughput, completion, latency, cost, or QPR fields parsed before the blind audit is sealed
